page.overview:
Who is Grand Chamberlain?

Around 110 AG, while the Grand Chamberlain was briefing Fire Lord Zuko on a conflict involving a Fire Navy vessel and the nonbender extremist group known as the Denied, he was interrupted by a messenger who announced the arrival of an urgent letter from Republic City. The chamberlain responded with irritation, reprimanding the messenger for interrupting the council session; however, Zuko intervened, surmising that the message was from the Avatar and ordering it to be read aloud.

When the messenger hesitated, the chamberlain urged him to proceed quickly. In the letter, Avatar Aang expressed hope that "the boring chamberlain you mentioned in your letters isn't still annoying you", prompting an awkward reaction among the council members. The Grand Chamberlain remained silent as the rest of the message was delivered.

Zuko subsequently joined the Avatar's quest. Upon his return to the Fire Nation Capital, the Fire Lord was once more briefed by the Grand Chamberlain on an extremely long list of issues, much to Zuko's annoyance.

The Grand Chamberlain was an elderly, cantankerous man characterized by a rigid and irritable temperament. He was prone to impatience and remained narrowly focused on procedural matters and the Fire Nation’s agenda, often to the frustration of those around him, including Fire Lord Zuko, who regarded him as both boring and irritating. He also maintained a harsh and authoritative demeanor toward subordinates, demonstrating a readiness to reprimand them for perceived breaches of protocol.
